newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia position strong after cut- Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia position strong after cut- Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the Reserve Bank's decision to cut official cash interest rates by 0.5 percentage points puts Australia in an extremely strong position.
Costello told reporters also that the bank should fully pass on the rate reduction to business borrowers.
"Today's cut in interest rates is very good news," Costello said.
"It is good news for business, it is good news for home buyers," he said.
"It is the reward for good economic management and it puts Australia in an extremely strong position over the course of the next financial year."
Costello said the Australian banks, only some of whom have responded to the latest central bank easing of monetary policy, should pass on the full 50 basis point cut to business customers.

"It is important that this rate cut is passed on in business lending in full because it is a reward for small business - to get small business into a stronger position as the result of lower rates so we can grow the economy faster."

The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said it would cut its overdraft and lending rates to key corporate and other commercial customers by a full 50 basis points. But it limited the reduction in its standard variable mortgage rate to 40 basis points.
Costello was critical of the major banks when the central bank eased rates on May 23 for not passing on the cuts to business and mortgage customers.
